forms.label: Rehoboam
forms.source: Essenthos, Rehoboam's Greek name read in NESTLE1904 Matthew 1:7 and GRCBRENT 1 Kings 12:1 by Codex, 2026-10-04
forms.why: The held Matthew 1:7 prints Ῥοβοάμ (G4497), Solomon's son; Brenton's 1 Kings 12:1 names the same king Ῥοβοὰμ. BibleData-PersonLabel.csv row Rehoboam_1_1 instead gives him Ιεροβοαμ and Ieroboam, which name Jeroboam. Correct only that original name row, keeping the Hebrew, numbering and other titles.

numbers.label: Rehoboam
numbers.why: Matthew 1:7 prints Rehoboam's name as Ῥοβοάμ, G4497, which Strong heads Roboam (i.e. Rechobam), an Israelite; the name row the dataset gave him carries no Greek number, so the Greek words that name him named nobody by number. No other record bears G4497.

numbers.label: Deborah
numbers.why: H1682 is deborah, the bee; the name is H1683, which Strong heads for two women, Rebekah's nurse and the prophetess who judged Israel. BibleData numbers the judge by the bee, and the person register gave the nurse it added the first number of the group.

numbers.label: Antichrist
numbers.why: G5000 is Tabitha; antichristos is G500, and the dataset's number has a digit too many. Left as it was, two records bear Tabitha's number and her name in Acts 9:36 and 9:40 names nobody.

numbers.label: Gomer
numbers.why: H1584 is gamar, to come to an end; the name is H1586, which Strong heads for Japheth's son and for Hosea's wife. Left as it was, the name in Hosea 1:3 resolves to Japheth's son alone, the only record bearing H1586.

numbers.label: Jaazaniah
numbers.why: Jeremiah 42:1 writes his name Jezaniah, H3153, the number of the word that names him. Left as it was, that word resolves to Jaazaniah the Maachathite's son alone, the only record bearing H3153.

numbers.label: Baanah
numbers.why: H1195 is Baana, Solomon's officers' father (1KI 4:12, 4:16) and Zadok's (NEH 3:4); Ish-bosheth's captain (2SA 4:2), the leader of the return (EZR 2:2, NEH 7:7) and the chief who sealed the covenant (NEH 10:27) are written Baanah, H1196, the number of the words that name them. Left as it was, those words resolve to the father of Heleb alone, the only record bearing H1196.

numbers.label: Ezer
numbers.why: H5827 is Ezer the Ephraimite of 1 Chronicles 7:21; the Gadite who came to David (1CH 12:9) and the repairer of the wall (NEH 3:19) are written H5829, the number of the words that name them. Left as it was, those words resolve to the son of Hur alone.

numbers.label: Areli
numbers.why: H6929 is Ziphion; Gad's son Areli is H692, the number of the words that name him (GEN 46:16, NUM 26:17).

numbers.label: Kore
numbers.why: H7124 is qore, the partridge; Hezekiah's porter Kore son of Imnah (2CH 31:14) is H6981, the number of the word that names him. Left as it was, that word resolves to the Korahite father of Shallum alone.

numbers.label: Shechem
numbers.why: H7927 is the town of Shechem; Shemida's son (1CH 7:19) is H7928, the number of the word that names him, which Strong heads for him and for Gilead's son.

numbers.label: Tekoa
numbers.why: H8619 is taqowa, a trumpet; Ashur's son Tekoa (1CH 2:24, 4:5) is H8620, the number of the words that name him, which Strong heads for the man and the town. Left as it was, those words resolve to the town alone.
